metadata.description: Skills built in the top30ongithub kit

plugins.name: top30-ops
plugins.description: Datadog app investigator: read-only logs, traces, monitors, deploys and incidents for one service, written up as an investigation report.

plugins.name: top30-data
plugins.description: Oracle-to-Snowflake translation with silent-difference checks, a Snowflake cost investigator, a per-query plan and tuning advisor, a Snowflake data-engineering agent team (researcher, drafter, critic, refiner) with a prod-write gate, and a read-only pipeline failure triage agent.

plugins.name: top30-coach
plugins.description: Skill trial coach: one skill at a time for a week, logged minutes saved, keep/extend/drop, and the next suggestion for your role.

plugins.name: top30-agents
plugins.description: Loops, graphs and harnesses: agent pattern picker and design audit, graph designer, loop harness, /goal writer, goal gate Stop hook, command picker, /batch scout, and a long-running harness starter (locked feature list, progress log) with a separate evaluator agent, and a session doctor that says which layer of a bad session failed.

plugins.name: top30-ui
plugins.description: EasyUI's and cult-ui's workflows plus motion forensics: components built to the components.build contract, your own shadcn registry, a read-only component reviewer, motion speed and render-cost checkers, a DESIGN.md keeper, a tilted 3D drill-down sunburst chart, and diagnosing and rebuilding how a site's animation is really built.

plugins.name: top30-private
plugins.description: Nothing leaves the machine without a yes: an egress gate hook that asks before commands, skills or connectors send data out or carry personal data, plus claude-mem-private and ecc-private agents that install Claude-Mem and ECC with telemetry off, no cloud sync and ask-first rules, then audit them.

plugins.name: top30-wensity
plugins.description: Wensity UI dashboards and sites: data file → dashboard plan on free primitives, one theme per project with a token check, landing-page section recipe, and scout/builder/QA agents that install only after approval.

plugins.name: top30-sparring
plugins.description: Push back instead of agreeing: hard mentor, case against a decision, A-vs-B, hard-conversation rehearsal and a questioning sounding board, with a decision log that scores your pre-mortems and confidence later, and a fresh-context devils-advocate agent.

plugins.name: top30-motion
plugins.description: Copy, style, move, sound, ship: a stack picker for the 18 motion repos, beat cues as frame numbers (librosa), word-timed captions from WhisperX (SRT, VTT, ASS karaoke, Remotion), licensed Openverse music with credits, and platform-ready exports at -14 LUFS checked with ffprobe; plus a motion-director agent.

plugins.name: top30-duet
plugins.description: Your own Claude Duet: a chief-of-staff folder with file memory, morning brief and weekly review, three-level permissions with an audit that checks they hold (folder trust included), promise and stale-note checks without a model, scheduled runs in dontAsk mode, and a read-only memory checker agent.
